prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1361; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good afternoon. This is a recorded statement for claim file reference that I will not read out. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the blue sedan involved in the accident. I'll give you what I can.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas, near a shopping center. I was in the right lane getting ready to move over into the middle lane because I needed to turn at the next light.

Q: What happened when you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and saw nothing close, so I signaled and started to move. Then I felt a hard bump on the driver's side. The other vehicle had come up in my blind spot and clipped my front quarter panel as it passed.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?

A: Not clearly. I glanced at the mirror and it looked like it was far back. By the time I looked again it was already beside me.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My right knee hit the lower part of the dashboard when the car jolted. It swelled up within an hour and I've had trouble putting weight on it since. I went to urgent care that evening and they took X-rays.

Q: Have you received any treatment since then?

A: I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week and I was told I may need an MRI. I'm still working out whether I need surgery.

Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?

A: Briefly. He apologized and said he didn't see me. We exchanged insurance information and that was about it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that my car has a dented door and a cracked headlight, and I'd like the repairs handled promptly.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
